sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The player didn't move! But the trail expanded from 2x2 to 4x4. So RIGHT toggled the trail size (from 2x2 to 4x4) but didn't move the player. This is strange - earlier RIGHT was blocked (no movement), and now RIGHT toggles the trail.
Wait, let me reconsider. Maybe the trail size affects movement. When the trail is 2x2, movement is disabled or different. When the trail is 4x4, movement works.
Looking at the pattern:
- When trail is 4x4:
  - LEFT → DOWN (moved)
  - UP → LEFT (moved)
  - RIGHT → blocked (no movement)
  - DOWN → RIGHT (moved)
  - UP → DOWN (moved)
- When trail is 2x2:
  - SPACE → toggled trail to 4x4
  - SPACE → toggled trail to 2x2
  - SPACE → toggled trail to 4x4
  - RIGHT → toggled trail to 4x4 (no movement)
Hmm, this doesn't quite fit. Let me look at the trail size before each action:
- Before LEFT: trail was 4x4, player moved DOWN
- Before UP: trail was 4x4, player moved LEFT
- Before RIGHT: trail was 4x4, player blocked
- Before DOWN: trail was 4x4, player moved RIGHT
- Before UP: trail was 4x4, player moved DOWN
- Before SPACE: trail was 4x4, toggled to 2x2
- Before SPACE: trail was 2x2, toggled to 4x4
- Before SPACE: trail was 4x4, toggled to 2x2
- Before RIGHT: trail was 2x2, toggled to 4x4
So when the trail is 2x2, any action (SPACE or RIGHT) toggles it back to 4x4 without moving. When the trail is 4x4, actions move the player (or are blocked).
Wait, but SPACE when trail is 4x4 toggled it to 2x2 without moving. So SPACE always toggles the trail, regardless of size. And directional movements when trail is 2x2 also toggle it to 4x4 without moving.
So the mechanic seems to be:
- When trail is 2x2: any action toggles trail to 4x4, no movement
- When trail is 4x4:
  - SPACE: toggles trail to 2x2, no movement
  - Directional: moves player (or blocked)
This means I need to keep the trail at 4x4 to move. Let me try moving with directional actions now that the trail is 4x4.
The player is at row 40-43, col 36-39. I want to move UP to reach the bottom blue box at row 37-38, col 33-34. Based on the pattern, RIGHT should move UP. Let me try RIGHT again.
